metadata.question: Was the primary direction of the Eyjafjallajökull volcanic plume toward the north rather than the south on May 10, 2010?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Eyjafjallajökull volcano in Iceland (approximately 63.63°N, 19.62°W) - Date: May 10, 2010 - Collection: MODIS aerosol optical depth (AOD) data (MCD19A2_GRANULES) or SO2 data would be ideal for volcanic plumes. Alternatively, use thermal anomalies or ash detection. - I'll use MODIS AOD to detect the plume direction 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - we're looking FOR the plume (aerosols/ash) - I need to compare AOD values north vs south of the volcano 3. Logic: - Define regions north and south of the volcano - Calculate mean AOD in each region - If north AOD > south AOD significantly, answer A (Yes) - If south AOD > north AOD or equal, answer B (No) - Handle C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (calculation failure) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions volcano_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 63.63]) # Eyjafjallajökull # Create regions north and south of volcano (extending ~200km in each direction) north_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-22, 63.63, -17, 65.5]) south_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-22, 61.5, -17, 63.63]) date_start = '2010-05-10' date_end = '2010-05-11' # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth aod_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .filterBounds(volcano_point) \ .select('Optical_Depth_055') print(f"AOD images found: {aod_col.size().getInfo()}") if aod_col.size().getInfo() == 0: # Try thermal anomaly as backup thermal_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .filterBounds(volcano_point) if thermal_col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS data available for May 10, 2010") print("C1") else: print("Insufficient aerosol data for plume direction analysis") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get AOD composite aod_img = aod_col.mean().multiply(0.001) # Scale factor for AOD # 4. Calculate AOD in north and south regions north_stats = aod_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=north_region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) south_stats = aod_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=south_region, scale=3000, maxPixels=1e9 ) north_aod = north_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_mean').getInfo() north_count = north_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo() south_aod = south_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_mean').getInfo() south_count = south_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo() print(f"North region - AOD: {north_aod}, Pixels: {north_count}") print(f"South region - AOD: {south_aod}, Pixels: {south_count}") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if north_count == 0 or south_count == 0: print("No valid pixels in comparison regions") print("C2") elif north_aod is None or south_aod is None: print("Calculation failed - invalid AOD values") print("C3") elif north_aod < 0 or south_aod < 0: print("Invalid AOD range detected") print("C3") else: print(f"AOD ratio (North/South): {north_aod/south_aod:.2f}") if north_aod > south_aod: print("Plume direction: Primarily NORTH") print("A") else: print("Plume direction: NOT primarily north") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
volcano_point = ee.Geometry.Point([-19.62, 63.63])  # Eyjafjallajökull

# Create regions north and south of volcano (extending ~200km in each direction)
north_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-22, 63.63, -17, 65.5])
south_region = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-22, 61.5, -17, 63.63])

date_start = '2010-05-10'
date_end = '2010-05-11'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Aerosol Optical Depth
aod_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(volcano_point) \
    .select('Optical_Depth_055')

print(f"AOD images found: {aod_col.size().getInfo()}")

if aod_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # Try thermal anomaly as backup
    thermal_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A1') \
        .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
        .filterBounds(volcano_point)
    
    if thermal_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        print("No MODIS data available for May 10, 2010")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    else:
        print("Insufficient aerosol data for plume direction analysis")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get AOD composite
    aod_img = aod_col.mean().multiply(0.001)  # Scale factor for AOD
    
    # 4. Calculate AOD in north and south regions
    north_stats = aod_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=north_region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    south_stats = aod_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=south_region,
        scale=3000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    north_aod = north_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_mean').getInfo()
    north_count = north_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo()
    south_aod = south_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_mean').getInfo()
    south_count = south_stats.get('Optical_Depth_055_count').getInfo()
    
    print(f"North region - AOD: {north_aod}, Pixels: {north_count}")
    print(f"South region - AOD: {south_aod}, Pixels: {south_count}")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if north_count == 0 or south_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels in comparison regions")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif north_aod is None or south_aod is None:
        print("Calculation failed - invalid AOD values")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif north_aod < 0 or south_aod < 0:
        print("Invalid AOD range detected")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"AOD ratio (North/South): {north_aod/south_aod:.2f}")
        
        if north_aod > south_aod:
            print("Plume direction: Primarily NORTH")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("Plume direction: NOT primarily north")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
